[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The enhance route is served by your own dsh host and reachable **only from this machine**:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Socket fence** — requests from non-loopback addresses are refused (`127.0.0.1` / `::1` only). No"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"te this means *any local process* can call the route; it carries no user authentication.
- **Host al"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"lowlist** — the route also validates the `Host` header against `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` / `[::1]`, "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"which defeats DNS-rebinding (a rebound attacker domain keeps the loopback socket address but carries"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" the attacker's hostname and is refused). Responses are `cache-control: no-store`.
- **Abuse caps** "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"— an `Origin` gate refuses browser calls from non-local pages, and from pages served by *any other* "},{"id":"p17s7","text":"local port (the origin's port must equal the port the request was addressed to, so a dev tool on `lo"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"calhost:4000` cannot spend your model quota); the route enforces a concurrency cap (`maxConcurrent`,"},{"id":"p17s9","text":" default 2) and a per-minute rate limit (`rateLimitPerMinute`, default 10), answering `429` beyond e"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"ither. Both counters live **in a single host process's memory**: multiple processes, a cluster, or s"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"everal profiles mounting the plugin each count independently, so the global cap would be exceeded — "},{"id":"p17s12","text":"this plugin supports single-process deployments only and ships no shared rate-limit store.
- **Proxy"},{"id":"p17s13","text":" rejection** — requests carrying `X-Forwarded-For` / `Forwarded` headers are refused outright: those"},{"id":"p17s14","text":" headers only exist when a proxy is in the path, which the trust model does not cover.
- **Request-l"},{"id":"p17s15","text":"evel timeouts are the host's and Node's job** — the plugin bounds the body size (including a Content"},{"id":"p17s16","text":"-Length fast reject) and the per-call `timeoutMs`; connection-level timeouts (headers / request time"},{"id":"p17s17","text":"out / keep-alive) are server-level settings on the shared `http.Server` that a prefix route must not"},{"id":"p17s18","text":" touch, so they fall to the host and Node's defaults (60 s headers / 300 s request).
- **Not for rev"},{"id":"p17s19","text":"erse-proxy exposure** — if you put dsh web behind a proxy that listens on the LAN, external callers "},{"id":"p17s20","text":"appear as loopback to the route and the fence is moot. Do not expose a proxied host without adding y"},{"id":"p17s21","text":"our own authentication at the proxy.
